description.value:
A carefully planned design lets you collapse your pawns into compact, innocuous forms. While a pawn is Inactive, you can fold it into a discreet, easily carried bundle with a single Interact action. In this form, the pawn's Bulk is reduced to half its normal value, rounded down to the nearest light Bulk, and onlookers must succeed at a Perception check against your class DC to recognize it for what it is. You can Take Control of a folded pawn without first returning it to its original form; it unfolds automatically and assumes a ready posture as normal.

Folding/unfolding isn't automated yet; toggle the Packed Pawn item's folded state by hand.
